_comment: Bulgarian/English false friends. 'word' is the English word; 'looks_like' is what a Bulgarian speaker assumes it means (the trap); 'actually' is the real meaning. 'vo' is the Bulgarian voice-over line for the scene. Edit freely — the assembler reads this file. 'prompt' is the ComfyUI image prompt; deliberately objects/places, never people, since the model is weak at hands.

items.vo: Fabric не е фабрика. Означава плат. Фабриката е factory.
items.prompt: folded bolts of luxurious textile fabric on a tailor's wooden table, soft window light, macro detail

items.vo: Magazine не е магазин. Означава списание. Магазинът е shop.
items.prompt: a stack of glossy magazines fanned on a marble coffee table, morning light, editorial photography
